q: What does the body of a candlestick show? 蜡烛实体表示什么？
why: The body spans open to close. The wicks (shadows) show the high and low of the period.

q: A doji has almost no body. What does it signal? 几乎无实体的十字星代表什么？
opts: Balance and indecision between buyers and sellers
why: Open and close land at nearly the same price - total balance. Treat it as indecision and wait for confirmation.

q: Which pattern is a bullish reversal signal after a downtrend? 下跌末端哪个是看涨反转信号？
why: A hammer - small body on top with a long lower shadow - appears after a downtrend and hints that buyers fought back.

q: In a bullish engulfing pattern, which candle swallows which? 看涨吞没中谁吞谁？
opts: A small green candle swallows a large red one
A large red candle swallows a small green one
A large green candle completely swallows the prior small red candle
why: Bullish engulfing = a big green body completely covers the previous small red body, hinting the trend may turn up.

q: A marubozu candle has no shadows at all. What does that tell you? 无影线的光头光脚线说明什么？
why: No shadows means price never pulled back - pure one-sided pressure in the direction of the candle.
